title: Immigration and the Supreme Court in the Early Days of the Second Trump Administration
affiliations: University of California, Davis - School of Law

detail.title: Immigration and the Supreme Court in the Early Days of the Second Trump Administration

publicationDetails.detailsText: UC Davis Legal Studies Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: University of California, Davis School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: St. Louis University Law Journal (forthcoming 2026) (Childress Lecture)

detail.abstract:
This paper is a lightly footnoted version on my Dean Richard J. Childress Memorial Lecture at St. Louis University School of Law in October 2025.  

With the inauguration of President Trump for his second term in January 2025, the first nine months of 2025 saw a series of unprecedented immigration enforcement operations.  Unlike anything seen in modern U.S. history, the actions have no less than shocked many observers, me included.  The immigration measures go far above and beyond those pursued in President Trump’s first term in office, which were aggressive themselves.  The centerpiece of the President’s dizzying array of immigration enforcement operations in 2025 is what he has proclaimed to be a mass deportation campaign targeting the “worst of the worst” criminal noncitizens. 

The Supreme Court has been asked to review the lawfulness of many of the administration’s immigration actions, including some cases requiring quick action and placed on the Court’s emergency, or shadow, docket (with limited briefing and oral arguments).  It responded in several instances with short opinions.  Consistent with the Court’s historical treatment of immigration matters, the Court’s rulings have been mixed, with the administration winning some cases and losing others.  This paper analyzes the Court's immigration rulings in the early days of President Trump's second term.

AI.tldr: 本文分析特朗普第二任期初期（2025年）最高法院对政府移民执法行动的裁决，这些裁决结果不一，反映了法院在移民问题上的一贯复杂立场。
AI.research_question: 在特朗普第二任期初期（2025年），最高法院如何裁决政府的移民执法行动？这些裁决反映了法院在移民问题上的何种立场和趋势？
AI.motivation: 2025年特朗普第二任期开始后，政府实施了前所未有的移民执法行动，包括大规模驱逐行动，这些行动引发了法律争议并提交至最高法院。作者作为观察者对这些行动感到震惊，认为有必要分析最高法院对这些争议的裁决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政权力与司法审查理论、移民法的宪法框架、最高法院在移民问题上的历史立场（司法尊重与干预的平衡）、紧急案件处理程序（影子备审案件程序）
AI.method: 法律分析方法，对最高法院在2025年特朗普第二任期初期移民案件中的裁决进行文本分析，包括常规案件和紧急案件（影子备审案件），比较法院在不同案件中的立场和推理。
AI.findings: 最高法院的裁决结果不一，政府在一些案件中获胜，在另一些案件中败诉。裁决反映了法院在移民问题上的一贯复杂立场，既不完全支持行政权力，也不完全否定。紧急案件的处理显示了法院在快速决策中的谨慎态度。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对最高法院在移民问题上司法立场的理解，揭示了在政治高度分化的时期法院如何平衡行政权力与法律约束。为紧急案件（影子备审案件）程序在移民争议中的应用提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律从业者、政策制定者和学者理解当前移民执法行动的法律边界提供参考。帮助预测未来类似移民争议在最高法院的可能结果。为移民权利倡导者和政府执法部门提供战略指导。

title: Интерактивные оценки технологий как инклюзивные формы управления технологическим развитием (Interactive Technology Assessment as Inclusive Form of Governance of Technological Development)
affiliations: Russian Academy of National Economy and Public Administration under the President of the Russian Federation (RANEPA) - North-West Institute of Management

detail.title: Интерактивные оценки технологий как инклюзивные формы управления технологическим развитием (Interactive Technology Assessment as Inclusive Form of Governance of Technological Development)
detail.abstract:
Russian Abstract: В статье рассматривается группа особых подходов к оценке технологий, которая получила название интерактивных мето- дов. В современных условиях имеется ряд предпосылок к раз- витию и применению данных методов оценивания: требования развивающейся демократии, сложный характер воздействия многих инновационных технологий, культурный плюрализм со- временного общества и другие. Интерактивные методы имеют обширные цели: оценка различных рисков, выяснение отноше- ния общества к той или иной инновации, прояснение возмож- ных конфликтов, содействие разработке взвешенной техно- логической политики. Оценка технологий может проводиться в разных вариантах. Так, в статье проводится различие оценки технологий в сильном и слабом смысле. Отмечается, что ин- терактивные методы имеют определенные недостатки. Кри- тически важным является адекватное использование лицами, принимающими решения, результатов интерактивной оценки.

English Abstract: The article discusses a group of special approaches to technology assessment, which is called interactive methods. In modern conditions, there are a number of prerequisites for the development and application of these assessment methods: the requirements of a developing democracy, the complex nature of the impact of many innovative technologies, the cultural pluralism of modern society, and others. Interactive methods have broad goals: evaluating various risks, exploring society’s attitude to a particular innovation, clarifying possible conflicts, and facilitating the development of a balanced technology policy. Technology assessment can be carried out in different ways. Thus, the article distinguishes technology assessment in a strong and weak sense. It is noted that interactive methods have certain disadvantages. It is critically important that decision makers make adequate use of the results of the interactive assessment.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了技术评估中的交互式方法，分析了其发展前提、目标、强/弱评估区分，并指出决策者需恰当运用评估结果。
AI.research_question: 交互式技术评估方法在现代社会中的适用性、优势与局限性是什么？如何区分强意义和弱意义的技术评估？
AI.motivation: 现代社会发展民主、创新技术影响复杂、文化多元等条件为交互式评估方法提供了发展前提，需要探索更有效的技术评估方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术评估理论、交互式评估方法、民主参与理论、风险管理理论、技术政策制定框架。
AI.method: 理论分析、概念区分（强/弱意义技术评估）、文献综述、案例研究（隐含在文中）。
AI.findings: 交互式方法具有广泛目标（风险评估、社会态度调查、冲突澄清、政策制定支持），但存在一定缺陷；区分了强/弱意义技术评估；决策者恰当运用评估结果至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了交互式技术评估方法的理论框架，明确了强/弱意义技术评估的区分标准，丰富了技术评估理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为技术评估实践提供了交互式方法指导，帮助决策者更好地利用评估结果制定平衡的技术政策，促进技术创新的社会接受度。

title: Эмерджентные формы открытого управления (open governance) как новые тенденции общественного участия в решении проблем городского управления (Emergent forms of open governance as new trends in public participation in solving urban governance problems)
affiliations: Russian Academy of National Economy and Public Administration under the President of the Russian Federation (RANEPA) - North-West Institute of Management

detail.title: Эмерджентные формы открытого управления (open governance) как новые тенденции общественного участия в решении проблем городского управления (Emergent forms of open governance as new trends in public participation in solving urban governance problems)
detail.abstract:
Russian Abstract: В статье рассматриваются проблемы становления новых форм публичного управления, связанных с возможностями, которые обеспечивают для гражданского участия новые информационные технологии. Эти формы подпадают под широкое понятие открытого управления, которое сегодня активно обсуждается с научной и практической точек зрения. Приводимые в статье примеры показывают, что данные формы обладают такими характеристиками, как эмерджентность, самоорганизация и массовое участие, а также демонстрируют такой общий паттерн, как формирование единого открытого оперативноинформационного пространства с неограниченным количеством участников. Обсуждается вопрос о том, можно ли считать эти тенденции началом формирования отдельной управленческой парадигмы. В статье рассматриваются вопросы дальнейшего расширения и развития подхода открытого управления для решения напряженных общественных проблем. Ключевые слова: открытое управление, открытое правительство, цифровизация управления, публичное управление, информационное общество, участие общественности.

English Abstract: The article discusses the problems of the formation new forms of public governance related to the opportunities provided by new information technologies for civil participation. These forms fall under the broad concept of open governance, which is currently being actively discussed from a scientific and practical perspective. The examples provided in the article show that these forms have such characteristics as emergence, self-organization, and mass participation, and also demonstrate a common pattern of forming an integrated open operational and information space with an unlimited number of participants. The article discusses whether these trends can be considered the beginning of a new governance paradigm. It explores the potential for further expansion and development of open governance approaches to address pressing societal challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了新兴信息技术如何催生新的公共治理形式，这些形式具有涌现性、自组织和大众参与等特点，可能构成新的治理范式，并讨论了开放治理方法在解决社会挑战中的扩展潜力。
AI.research_question: 新兴信息技术如何催生新的公共治理形式？这些具有涌现性、自组织和大众参与特征的开放治理形式是否构成新的治理范式？
AI.motivation: 信息技术为公民参与提供了新机会，催生了新的公共治理形式，这些形式被归为"开放治理"概念，目前从科学和实践角度都在积极讨论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开放治理理论、数字治理理论、信息社会理论、公共参与理论、自组织理论
AI.method: 概念分析、案例研究、模式识别
AI.findings: 新兴的公共治理形式具有涌现性、自组织和大众参与特征，展现出形成统一开放操作信息空间的共同模式，参与者数量不受限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了开放治理作为新兴治理范式的理论框架，识别了其关键特征（涌现性、自组织、大众参与），探讨了信息技术驱动的治理模式转变。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共管理者提供了开放治理的实践模式，展示了如何利用信息技术促进公民参与，为解决紧迫社会问题提供了新的治理方法。

title: The Housing Market in China: An Estimated DSGE Model

detail.title: The Housing Market in China: An Estimated DSGE Model
detail.abstract: This study develops a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) model incorporating housing, banking, and government sectors, with a focus on the role of dynamic land prices in China's economy. The model is calibrated using Chinese macroeconomic data and demonstrates a strong fit with observed business cycle fluctuations. Through shock decomposition analysis, we identify capital shocks, housing supply shocks, and housing demand shocks as the primary drivers of variations in consumption, investment, loans, and house prices. Impulse response analysis reveals that the banking sector amplifies economic shocks, while local government activities-acting as the dominant land supplier-crowd out household consumption and significantly influence macroeconomic dynamics. Furthermore, welfare analysis shows that government control over land reduces overall social welfare, whereas the presence of the banking sector enhances it. The model offers a new DSGE benchmark for China's business cycle analysis.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个包含住房、银行和政府部门的DSGE模型，重点分析动态土地价格在中国经济中的作用。模型校准显示与中国宏观经济数据拟合良好，识别出资本冲击、住房供给冲击和需求冲击是主要经济波动来源。银行部门放大经济冲击，地方政府作为主要土地供应者挤出居民消费，土地控制降低社会福利而银行部门提升福利。
AI.research_question: 动态土地价格在中国经济周期波动中扮演什么角色？住房、银行和政府部门的互动如何影响中国的宏观经济动态？
AI.motivation: 中国房地产市场在经济中占据重要地位，土地价格动态、银行信贷和政府土地供应政策对经济周期有显著影响，但现有DSGE模型未能充分整合这些要素，需要构建专门针对中国经济的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）理论框架，特别整合了住房市场理论、银行信贷理论和政府干预理论，强调土地价格动态在经济周期传导机制中的作用。
AI.method: 构建包含住房、银行和政府部门的DSGE模型，使用中国宏观经济数据进行校准，进行冲击分解分析和脉冲响应分析，评估不同冲击对经济变量的影响，并进行福利分析。
AI.findings: 1. 资本冲击、住房供给冲击和住房需求冲击是消费、投资、贷款和房价波动的主要驱动因素；2. 银行部门放大经济冲击；3. 地方政府作为主要土地供应者挤出居民消费并显著影响宏观经济动态；4. 政府土地控制降低社会福利，而银行部门提升社会福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 构建了专门针对中国经济的DSGE模型，整合了住房、银行和政府三个关键部门；2. 强调了土地价格动态在经济周期分析中的核心作用；3. 为中国经济周期分析提供了新的DSGE基准模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了评估土地政策、住房政策和银行监管政策对宏观经济影响的分析工具；2. 揭示了政府土地控制的社会福利成本；3. 强调了银行部门在经济稳定中的双重作用（放大冲击但提升福利）。

title: Paid With(out) Purpose: Perceptions, Preferences, and the Meaning of Work

detail.title: Paid With(out) Purpose: Perceptions, Preferences, and the Meaning of Work

declarations.ethicsApproval: This design was approved by the Institutional Review Board (IRB) at UC Davis - Protocol # 2225085-2.
declarations.funderStatement: Funding for this experiment received from UC Davis Department of Economics Graduate Research Award and 2025 Bacon Family Summer Fellowship.

detail.abstract: I develop a novel online experiment with 387 subjects on Prolific and simple utility model to examine how workers respond to reported work meaning. Workers appear to value different aspects of work and be willing to give up other incentives for their best work match. 31% of workers appear not to value meaning in their work, 27% appear not to value work pay, 30% appear to value both, and 12% cannot be characterized. Overall, 57% of workers are willing to sacrifice up to 14% of possible pay in their pursuit of meaningful work. For workers who value work meaning, I estimate positive impacts of meaningfulness on the quantity and quality of output, although these effects appear only for a task with prosocial framing. Finally, I validate a light-touch treatment designed to increase worker awareness of the value they place on meaning, again finding effects only for workers who seek meaning in their work. Importantly, raising worker awareness of work meaning has no impact on the types of incentives they seek out. These results offer insights into how such interventions and preferences for work meaning might be leveraged in organizational settings.

AI.tldr: 通过在线实验研究发现，工人对工作意义的重视程度存在异质性：31%不重视意义，27%不重视薪酬，30%两者都重视，12%无法归类。57%的工人愿意为追求有意义的工作牺牲高达14%的潜在薪酬。对于重视工作意义的工人，有意义性对产出数量和质量有积极影响，但仅出现在具有亲社会框架的任务中。提高工人对工作意义价值的认知仅对寻求意义的工人有效，且不影响他们寻求的激励类型。
AI.research_question: 工人如何对报告的工作意义做出反应？工人对工作意义和薪酬的重视程度如何？工作意义对工人的产出数量和质量有何影响？提高工人对工作意义价值的认知会产生什么效果？
AI.motivation: 理解工人对工作意义的偏好和反应对于组织管理具有重要意义。现有研究对工人如何权衡工作意义与薪酬激励的了解有限，特别是在不同任务框架下的影响差异。本研究旨在填补这一空白，为组织设计更有效的工作激励和干预措施提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于简单的效用模型，研究工人对工作意义的偏好异质性。理论框架包括工作意义与薪酬的权衡、工人类型分类（重视意义型、重视薪酬型、两者都重视型、无法归类型），以及工作意义对产出绩效的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用在线实验方法，在Prolific平台上招募387名被试。设计实验任务，包括具有亲社会框架的任务和其他任务。使用简单的效用模型分析工人对工作意义和薪酬的偏好。实施轻触干预措施提高工人对工作意义价值的认知，并评估其效果。
AI.findings: 1. 工人对工作意义的重视程度存在显著异质性：31%不重视意义，27%不重视薪酬，30%两者都重视，12%无法归类。2. 57%的工人愿意为追求有意义的工作牺牲高达14%的潜在薪酬。3. 对于重视工作意义的工人，有意义性对产出数量和质量有积极影响，但仅出现在具有亲社会框架的任务中。4. 提高工人对工作意义价值的认知仅对寻求意义的工人有效，且不影响他们寻求的激励类型。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了工人对工作意义偏好的异质性分类框架。2. 建立了工作意义与薪酬权衡的实证模型。3. 揭示了任务框架（亲社会性）在工作意义影响产出绩效中的调节作用。4. 发展了工人自我认知干预的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为组织设计差异化的工作激励方案提供指导：针对不同类型的工人采取不同的管理策略。2. 建议在具有亲社会性质的任务中强调工作意义以提高绩效。3. 提供轻触干预措施提高工人对工作意义的认知，但需针对重视意义的工人群体。4. 帮助组织理解工人愿意为有意义工作牺牲薪酬的程度，优化薪酬结构设计。

title: Correcting Second-Order Beliefs across the Political Divide: Experimental Evidence on Climate Change Beliefs

detail.title: Correcting Second-Order Beliefs across the Political Divide: Experimental Evidence on Climate Change Beliefs
detail.abstract: Misperceptions of what others think are widespread and shape how individuals form their own beliefs and take actions. On polarizing issues, the effect of correcting these misperceptions may depend on political affiliation. I examine this through a preregistered online experiment on climate change beliefs, a highly polarized issue in the United States. Using incentive-compatible methods, I elicit participants’ own beliefs and their beliefs about others’ beliefs (second-order beliefs). I then provide randomized information about others’ actual beliefs from either a co-partisan or an opposing partisan source, and observe the updated beliefs and pro-climate actions. I find that correcting misperceptions in second-order beliefs affects one’s own beliefs and actions about climate change, and the effects depend on whether the individual and the information source are politically aligned. Stronger pro-climate beliefs from co-partisans increase individuals’ own pro-climate beliefs and behaviors, while identical information from opposing partisans generates backlash. These results suggest that uniform social information campaigns may have a limited impact on polarized issues, while tailoring messages to match the audience’s political affiliation offers a more promising strategy for improving engagement.

AI.tldr: 本文通过预注册在线实验研究气候变化信念中的错误认知纠正效果，发现纠正他人信念的错误认知会影响个人信念和行动，但效果取决于信息来源的政治立场是否与个体一致。来自同党派的信息能增强亲气候信念和行为，而来自对立党派的信息则产生反效果。
AI.research_question: 纠正关于他人信念的错误认知如何影响个人在气候变化等极化议题上的信念和行为？这种影响是否取决于信息来源的政治立场是否与个体一致？
AI.motivation: 错误认知普遍存在并影响个人信念形成和行动决策。在极化议题上，纠正这些错误认知的效果可能因政治立场而异。气候变化是美国高度极化的议题，研究不同政治立场信息来源对纠正效果的影响具有重要理论和实践意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会认知理论、信念形成理论和政治极化理论，探讨错误认知纠正、信息来源政治立场对个人信念和行为的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用预注册在线实验设计，使用激励相容方法测量参与者自身信念和关于他人信念的二级信念。随机提供来自同党派或对立党派信息来源的他人实际信念信息，观察信念更新和亲气候行动变化。
AI.findings: 纠正二级信念中的错误认知会影响个人气候变化信念和行动，效果取决于信息来源政治立场是否与个体一致。来自同党派的亲气候信息增强个人亲气候信念和行为，而来自对立党派的相同信息产生反效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献包括：1）阐明错误认知纠正对极化议题信念形成的影响机制；2）揭示信息来源政治立场在信念更新中的调节作用；3）为政治极化情境下的社会影响理论提供实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践启示：统一的社会信息运动在极化议题上效果有限，而根据受众政治立场定制信息是更有效的策略。政策制定者和倡导组织应考虑信息来源政治立场来设计更有效的气候变化沟通策略。

title: Macroeconomic Trends 2026: Global Outlook Based on 2000-2025 Data
affiliations: Asian School Bahrain

detail.title: Macroeconomic Trends 2026: Global Outlook Based on 2000-2025 Data
detail.abstract: This report analyzes two and a half decades of global macroeconomic data to forecast the direction of global growth, trade, inflation, and financial stability in 2026. Drawing from multilateral sources including the IMF, World Bank, WTO, and BIS, the analysis highlights a cautiously stable world economy expected to expand around 3.1 percent. Structural forces-aging demographics, artificial intelligence capital expenditure, the energy transition, and fragmented industrial policies-shape this outlook. The findings underline the need for portfolio strategies emphasizing diversification, balance sheet strength, and exposure to long-term technological trends.

AI.tldr: 该报告分析了25年的全球宏观经济数据，预测2026年全球增长、贸易、通胀和金融稳定性的方向。基于IMF、世界银行、WTO和BIS等多边数据，分析显示世界经济将谨慎稳定地扩张约3.1%。结构性力量——人口老龄化、人工智能资本支出、能源转型和碎片化产业政策——塑造了这一前景。
AI.research_question: 2026年全球经济增长、贸易、通胀和金融稳定性的方向是什么？哪些结构性力量将塑造这一经济前景？
AI.motivation: 理解全球经济的长期趋势和结构性变化，为投资组合策略提供决策依据。通过分析25年的宏观经济数据，识别影响未来经济前景的关键因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观经济预测理论、结构性增长理论、人口经济学、技术变革理论、能源转型经济学、产业政策分析框架。
AI.method: 基于IMF、世界银行、WTO和BIS等多边机构的25年全球宏观经济数据分析，采用定量预测方法和结构性因素分析。
AI.findings: 世界经济预计将谨慎稳定地扩张约3.1%。四大结构性力量塑造前景：人口老龄化、人工智能资本支出、能源转型和碎片化产业政策。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别了塑造未来全球经济前景的四大结构性力量框架，为理解长期经济趋势提供了整合分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资组合策略提供具体建议：强调多元化、资产负债表强度和长期技术趋势敞口。为政策制定者和投资者提供2026年经济前景的预测框架。

title: To What Extent Does Classical Economic Theory Explain the Real-World Performance of the Tesla Model 3 in the Non-Colluding Battery Electric Vehicle Oligopoly?
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: To What Extent Does Classical Economic Theory Explain the Real-World Performance of the Tesla Model 3 in the Non-Colluding Battery Electric Vehicle Oligopoly?
detail.abstract: This research tested the limits of classical economic theory in explaining the global EV market. I gauged how classical theory accounts for Tesla's dominance over lower-priced competitors (e.g. Hyundai Ioniq) using empirical sales data and theoretical modeling. Rational-choice and oligopoly predictions were compared to real-world data. When data diverged, behavioural economic models (e.g. anchoring, framing, bounded rationality) were considered as an alternative. I discovered that perception and emotion influenced by anchoring, framing, and Tesla’s mission-driven brand image under Elon Musk can often trump price and utility.

AI.tldr: 该研究测试了古典经济理论在解释全球电动汽车市场时的局限性，发现特斯拉通过锚定效应、框架效应和使命驱动的品牌形象，其感知和情感因素往往能超越价格和实用性的影响，从而主导市场。
AI.research_question: 古典经济理论在多大程度上能够解释特斯拉在全球电动汽车市场中相对于低价竞争对手（如现代Ioniq）的主导地位？
AI.motivation: 测试古典经济理论在解释全球电动汽车市场动态时的局限性，特别是当特斯拉这样的高价品牌能够主导市场，而低价竞争对手却难以获得市场份额时。
AI.theoretical_framework: 古典经济理论（理性选择理论、寡头垄断理论）和行为经济学理论（锚定效应、框架效应、有限理性）。
AI.method: 使用实证销售数据和理论建模，比较理性选择和寡头垄断预测与现实世界数据，当数据出现分歧时考虑行为经济学模型作为替代解释。
AI.findings: 感知和情感因素（受锚定效应、框架效应和特斯拉在埃隆·马斯克领导下的使命驱动品牌形象影响）往往能够超越价格和实用性的影响，这解释了特斯拉的市场主导地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了古典经济理论在解释复杂市场行为时的局限性，强调了行为经济学因素（如锚定、框架、品牌情感）在理解消费者选择和市场动态中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电动汽车制造商提供了战略启示：除了价格和实用性外，品牌形象、情感连接和认知框架对市场成功至关重要；帮助政策制定者更全面地理解市场动态。

title: Modeling Irrational Consumer Decisions Using Perceived Utility Functions and Markov Chains
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Modeling Irrational Consumer Decisions Using Perceived Utility Functions and Markov Chains

contentType.other: IB DP HL Math A&I IA

detail.abstract: This research coded a simulation using Markov Chains to mathematically model consumer irrationality in food-delivery decisions (e.g. UberEats). Probability theory was applied within behavioural economics to simulate transitions between emotional states (frugal, tempted, impulsive) and their effect on purchase behaviour. The model replicated real-world spending patterns, demonstrating that irrational behaviour follows a probabilistic order. Through this work, I discovered how mathematical systems can reveal structure in human unpredictability, a logic beneath emotion.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用马尔可夫链模拟消费者在食品配送决策中的非理性行为，通过概率理论模拟情绪状态转换及其对购买行为的影响，发现非理性行为遵循概率顺序。
AI.research_question: 消费者在食品配送决策（如UberEats）中的非理性行为如何通过数学模型进行描述和预测？
AI.motivation: 理解消费者在食品配送平台上的非理性决策模式，探索数学系统如何揭示人类不可预测行为背后的结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学、马尔可夫链理论、概率论、情绪状态转换理论
AI.method: 使用马尔可夫链建立数学模型，模拟消费者在三种情绪状态（节俭、诱惑、冲动）之间的转换，并分析这些状态对购买决策的影响。
AI.findings: 模型成功复制了现实世界的消费模式，表明非理性行为遵循概率顺序，情绪状态转换具有可预测的数学结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 将概率理论应用于行为经济学，为消费者非理性决策提供了数学建模框架，揭示了情绪状态转换的数学规律。
AI.practical_contributions: 为食品配送平台提供消费者行为预测工具，帮助企业理解用户决策模式，优化营销策略和服务设计。

title: The Cost of Scrolling: A Study on the Impact of Short-Form Video Consumption on Financial Decision-Making Patterns
affiliations: Behavioural Finance Researcher

detail.title: The Cost of Scrolling: A Study on the Impact of Short-Form Video Consumption on Financial Decision-Making Patterns

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no conflicts of interest related to this research. This study was conducted independently, without any financial support, sponsorship, or influence from external organizations.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve any clinical participants or sensitive personal data. All survey responses were collected anonymously and voluntarily. Therefore, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded and conducted independently by the author, without any financial support or sponsorship from external organizations.

detail.abstract: This study investigates the profound influence of short-form video consumption on the financial decision making patterns of young investors in India. As digital platforms increasingly permeate daily life, concerns arise regarding their impact on cognitive functions essential for sound financial planning. This research aims to understand how habits formed through engaging with rapid, dopamine-driven content might alter attention spans, patience, and risk perception, subsequently affecting saving behaviors, investment choices, and overall financial discipline. A mixed-methods approach, primarily utilizing surveys combined with hypothetical financial scenarios, was employed with a sample of young Indian investors aged 18 to 35. Preliminary findings suggest a discernible correlation between higher short-form video engagement and a preference for immediate gratification, reduced long-term financial planning, and a potential inclination towards speculative investments. The study highlights an emerging challenge in nurturing financially astute generations and underscores the need for conscious digital consumption and targeted financial literacy initiatives.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了短视频消费对印度年轻投资者财务决策模式的深刻影响，发现高短视频参与度与即时满足偏好、长期财务规划减少以及投机投资倾向相关。
AI.research_question: 短视频消费如何影响印度年轻投资者的财务决策模式？具体如何改变注意力持续时间、耐心和风险感知，进而影响储蓄行为、投资选择和整体财务纪律？
AI.motivation: 随着数字平台日益渗透日常生活，人们担心它们对健全财务规划所必需的认知功能产生影响。研究旨在理解通过接触快速、多巴胺驱动内容形成的习惯如何改变年轻投资者的财务行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字媒体消费对认知功能影响的理论，特别是注意力持续时间、耐心和风险感知的变化如何影响财务决策。涉及即时满足偏好、长期规划能力和风险承受能力等概念。
AI.method: 采用混合方法，主要使用调查问卷结合假设性财务情景，样本为18-35岁的印度年轻投资者。
AI.findings: 初步发现表明，较高的短视频参与度与即时满足偏好、长期财务规划减少以及潜在的投机投资倾向之间存在可辨别的相关性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为数字媒体消费对财务决策影响的理论框架提供了实证支持，特别强调了短视频这种特定形式内容对年轻投资者认知功能和决策模式的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了培养财务精明一代的新兴挑战，指出了有意识的数字消费和针对性金融素养计划的必要性，为政策制定者和教育工作者提供了实践指导。

title: Computation as a Game
affiliations: Imperial College London - Department of Mathematics

detail.title: Computation as a Game
detail.abstract: We present a unifying representation of computation as a two-player game between an Algorithm and Nature, grounded in domain theory and game theory. The Algorithm produces progressively refined approximations within a Scott domain, while Nature assigns penalties proportional to their distance from the true value. Correctness corresponds to equilibrium in the limit of refinement. This framework allows us to define complexity classes game-theoretically, characterizing P, NP, and related classes as sets of problems admitting particular equilibria. The open question P ? = NP becomes a problem about the equivalence of Nash equilibria under differing informational and temporal constraints. We then extend the game-theoretic interpretation of computation into a probabilistic and collective setting, formulating a mean-field theory of computation. Each individual computation is modeled as a stochastic process on a domain, interacting weakly with the aggregate distribution of other computations. We derive equilibrium conditions analogous to those of mean-field games and interpret complexity classes in terms of the structure and stability of these equilibria. The P vs. NP question thus becomes a question of whether deterministic mean-field equilibria can approximate their existentially quantified counterparts in the large-population limit. Finally, we present a categorical formulation of the game-theoretic theory of computation. In this view, programs are morphisms in a cartesian closed category, computational refinement corresponds to the internal order in a domain object, and equilibria are fixed points of endofunctors representing interaction between an Algorithm and Nature. Complexity classes arise as subcategories defined by resource-bounded morphisms. The question P ? = NP becomes the question of whether two endofunctors-deterministic and existential-are isomorphic in the topos of feasible computations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一的计算表示框架，将计算视为算法与自然之间的两人博弈，基于域理论和博弈论。该框架能够从博弈论角度定义复杂度类，将P vs. NP问题转化为均衡等价性问题，并扩展到概率集体计算和范畴论表述。
AI.research_question: 如何通过博弈论框架统一表示计算过程？如何将复杂度类（特别是P vs. NP问题）转化为博弈论中的均衡问题？如何将计算理论扩展到概率集体设置和范畴论表述？
AI.motivation: 传统计算理论缺乏统一的框架来连接计算过程、复杂度类和博弈论概念。需要一个新的视角来重新理解计算本质，特别是P vs. NP这一核心未解问题。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 域理论（Scott域）：用于表示计算的渐进精化过程
2. 博弈论：将计算建模为算法与自然之间的两人博弈
3. 平均场理论：将计算扩展到概率集体设置
4. 范畴论：提供计算的结构化数学表述
AI.method:
1. 构建算法与自然的博弈模型，其中算法在Scott域中产生渐进近似，自然根据与真实值的距离分配惩罚
2. 将复杂度类定义为允许特定均衡的问题集合
3. 扩展为平均场计算理论，将个体计算建模为域上的随机过程
4. 提供范畴论表述，将程序视为笛卡尔闭范畴中的态射
AI.findings:
1. 计算可以统一表示为算法与自然之间的博弈
2. 正确性对应于精化极限中的均衡
3. P、NP等复杂度类可以博弈论地定义为允许特定均衡的问题集合
4. P vs. NP问题转化为纳什均衡在不同信息和时间约束下的等价性问题
5. 平均场框架下，P vs. NP问题变为确定性平均场均衡能否在大量极限中近似存在量化对应物的问题
6. 范畴论表述中，P vs. NP问题变为两个自函子（确定性和存在性）在可行计算topos中是否同构的问题
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了计算作为博弈的统一表示框架
2. 建立了复杂度类与博弈均衡之间的对应关系
3. 将P vs. NP问题重新表述为均衡理论问题
4. 扩展了平均场理论到计算领域
5. 提供了计算的范畴论表述
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为理解计算本质提供了新的理论视角
2. 为复杂度分析提供了新的工具和方法
3. 可能为算法设计和分析提供新思路
4. 为跨学科研究（计算理论、博弈论、范畴论）搭建了桥梁

title: Трансдисциплинарные проекты городского развития: сущность и основные проблемы (Transdisciplinary Urban Development Projects: The Essence and Main Problems)
affiliations: Russian Academy of National Economy and Public Administration under the President of the Russian Federation (RANEPA) - North-West Institute of Management

detail.title: Трансдисциплинарные проекты городского развития: сущность и основные проблемы (Transdisciplinary Urban Development Projects: The Essence and Main Problems)
detail.abstract:
Russian Abstract: Трансдисциплинарные исследования и разработки все шире применяются в настоящее время для решения проблем город- ского управления и развития. В статье рассматривается сущ- ность трансдисциплинарного подхода, приводятся его опре- деления и основные характеристики. Обсуждаются типичные сложности данного подхода (трудоемкость, трудности прео- доления дисциплинарных границ и интеграции знаний и т.п.). В связи с этим в статье предлагается более реалистичный подход, включающий умеренные начальные цели и установки исследования, не предполагающие обязательного преодоле- ния дисциплинарных границ и получения радикально нового знания. При этом само планирование трансдисциплинарного исследования должно сопровождаться тщательным обоснова- нием выбора данной формы взаимодействия участников. Уме- ренная исходная установка проекта может далее трансформи- роваться в более сильный вариант в процессе развертывания самой логики разработки решаемой проблемы.

English Abstract: Transdisciplinary research and development is increasingly being applied to address urban governance and development issues. The article examines the essence of the transdisciplinary approach, provides its definitions and main characteristics. The typical difficulties of this approach (labor intensity, difficulties in overcoming disciplinary boundaries and integrating knowledge, etc.) are discussed. In this regard, the article suggests a more realistic approach, including moderate initial goals and research objectives that do not necessarily involve overcoming disciplinary boundaries and obtaining radically new knowledge. At the same time, the planning of transdisciplinary research itself should be accompanied by a thorough justification of the choice of this form of interaction between the participants. The moderate initial setup of the project can further transform into a stronger version in the process of deploying the very logic of developing the problem being solved.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种更务实的跨学科研究方法，针对城市治理与发展问题，建议采用适度的初始目标，不强求突破学科边界或获得全新知识，而是在项目推进过程中逐步深化研究强度。
AI.research_question: 如何设计更现实可行的跨学科研究方法来应对城市治理与发展中的复杂问题？
AI.motivation: 跨学科研究在城市治理与发展中应用日益广泛，但面临劳动强度大、难以突破学科边界、知识整合困难等挑战，需要更务实的研究方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨学科研究理论，包括其定义、特征、实施难点，以及研究设计中的现实主义转向。
AI.method: 概念性分析论文，通过文献综述和理论探讨，提出改进的跨学科研究框架。
AI.findings: 1) 跨学科研究面临实施困难；2) 建议采用适度初始目标的研究设计；3) 研究规划需充分论证参与者互动形式的选择；4) 项目可在推进过程中从适度目标转向更强版本。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"适度现实主义"的跨学科研究框架，为跨学科研究理论提供了更务实的设计思路，强调研究过程的动态演化特性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市治理与发展领域的实践者提供了更可行的跨学科研究实施指南，降低了研究门槛，提高了项目成功的可能性。

title: Time-Varying SRDB Component Weights -  Economic Cycle Theory, Convergence Dynamics, and Regime-Dependent Inflation Transmission - Complete Framework with Comprehensive Appendices, Country-Specific Estimates, and Full Validation
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Time-Varying SRDB Component Weights -  Economic Cycle Theory, Convergence Dynamics, and Regime-Dependent Inflation Transmission - Complete Framework with Comprehensive Appendices, Country-Specific Estimates, and Full Validation

keywords: and Regime-Dependent Inflation Transmission Complete Framework with Comprehensive Appendices

detail.abstract: This paper extends the Systemic Risk of Doing Business (SRDB) inflation framework by modeling timevarying component weights w j,t that evolve according to economic cycle theory and convergence dynamics. Prior work assumed constant weights (w 1 , w 2 , w 3) = (0.24, 0.57, 0.19) derived via GMM. We demonstrate that weights evolve systematically over economic cycles and across development stages. Key Results: (1) Financial risk weight w 2 varies 0.42-0.71 over Kondratiev long-wave cycle (40-60 years), peaking during downswings (2008-20: 0.71, +34% vs average). (2) Computational cost weight w 1 varies 0.18-0.32 over Juglar medium-cycle (7-11 years), peaking during credit booms (+78% swing). (3) All three weights exhibit β-convergence (β < 0, p < 0.01) with half-lives 22-38 years. (4) Crosscountry weight dispersion declines σ = 0.18 (1970) → 0.08 (2020)-σ-convergence confirmed (56% reduction). (5) Emerging economies weight structural fragility 0.30 vs advanced 0.16; advanced economies weight financial risk 0.62 vs emerging 0.42. (6) Markov-switching identifies 4 K-wave phases; SRDB transmission elasticity γ ranges 0.68-0.92 across regimes. (7) Time-varying weights improve RMSE 18.6% (average), 24.4% (Markov-switching), 44% (crisis periods). (8) State-space Kalman filter with time-varying parameters outperforms fixed-weight specification on all metrics. Methodological Contributions: (1) Integration of three economic cycle theories (Kondratiev, Juglar, Kitchin) with inflation dynamics. (2) Convergence analysis (15 countries, 1960-2025) showing institutional and development determinants of weight evolution. (3) State-space model with exogenous cycle indicators and convergence drivers. (4) Hamilton Markov-switching regime identification matching historical K-wave phases. (5) Complete appendices with country-specific results (15 nations), Kondratiev wave dating, Kalman filter algorithm, and Markov-switching EM procedure. Policy Implications: Central banks should adjust SRDB component emphasis based on cycle phase (financial stress dominates during K-wave downswings; computational stress during Juglar booms) and development stage (structural fragility priority for emerging economies). Forecasting gains of 44% during crises demonstrate practical value.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了系统性商业风险通胀框架，通过建模随时间变化的权重来反映经济周期理论和收敛动态。研究发现权重随经济周期和发展阶段系统性变化，时间变化权重显著提高了预测精度。
AI.research_question: 系统性商业风险通胀框架中的权重是否随时间变化？这些变化如何受经济周期和发展阶段影响？时间变化权重是否能提高预测精度？
AI.motivation: 先前研究假设SRDB通胀框架的权重是恒定的，但实际经济环境是动态变化的，需要探索权重随时间变化的特性及其与经济周期的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济周期理论（康德拉季耶夫长波、朱格拉中波、基钦短波）、收敛理论（β收敛和σ收敛）、状态空间模型、马尔可夫转换模型
AI.method: 采用状态空间卡尔曼滤波模型，结合外生周期指标和收敛驱动因素；使用汉密尔顿马尔可夫转换识别经济周期阶段；分析15个国家1960-2025年的数据
AI.findings: 1）金融风险权重在康德拉季耶夫周期中变化0.42-0.71；2）计算成本权重在朱格拉周期中变化0.18-0.32；3）权重存在β收敛；4）跨国权重分散度下降56%；5）新兴与发达经济体权重结构差异显著；6）识别出4个康波阶段；7）时间变化权重提高预测精度18.6%-44%
AI.theory_contributions: 1）整合三种经济周期理论与通胀动态；2）展示权重演化的制度和发展决定因素；3）建立包含外生周期指标的状态空间模型；4）匹配历史康波阶段的马尔可夫转换识别
AI.practical_contributions: 1）央行应根据周期阶段调整SRDB组件重点；2）新兴经济体应优先关注结构性脆弱性；3）危机期间预测精度提高44%具有实际价值；4）提供国家特定结果和算法细节

title: How Middle Powers May Prevent the Development of Artificial Superintelligence
affiliations: , Conjecture, Control AI and Conjecture

detail.title: How Middle Powers May Prevent the Development of Artificial Superintelligence
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) development, and especially the pursuit of artificial superintelligence (ASI), presents unprecedented risks to international security, potentially enabling any actor who develops it first to achieve decisive strategic advantage over all others; alternatively, it may result in humanity's extinction if humanity loses control of a powerful AI system. Middle powers are particularly well-incentivized to kickstart international coordination aimed at preventing the development of ASI by any actor. In this work, we propose an international agreement which would enable a coalition of middle powers to deter dangerous AI R&D and eventually achieve a regime of international coordination in which AI R&D is restricted and thoroughly monitored in order to prevent the development of ASI. The agreement establishes this deterrence through clearly defined AI R&D redlines tied to specific, graduated countermeasures. These measures range from export controls, through various levels of sanctions, and culminate in the recognition of self-defense rights when the most egregiously dangerous redlines are breached. Member states must commit to escalating deterrence measures in unison; this way, they may meaningfully deter dangerous AI R&D by any actor, including superpowers. The effectiveness of this initiative critically depends on timing. Once actors are confident that they may achieve decisive strategic advantage through AI R&D, they may be willing to endure extraordinary costs as a temporary price for permanent global dominance; earlier implementation can achieve the agreement's goals without resorting to extreme measures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个由中等强国主导的国际协议，通过设定明确的AI研发红线及分级反制措施，防止任何国家开发危险的人工超级智能，避免国际安全风险或人类灭绝威胁。
AI.research_question: 中等强国如何通过国际合作机制有效防止危险的人工超级智能研发，特别是如何威慑包括超级大国在内的所有行为体？
AI.motivation: 人工智能发展，特别是人工超级智能的追求，对国际安全构成前所未有的风险：可能让首个开发者获得决定性战略优势，或导致人类失去对强大AI系统的控制而灭绝。中等强国特别有动机启动国际合作来防止任何行为体开发ASI。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际安全理论、威慑理论、集体行动理论、分级响应机制、国际协调机制
AI.method: 提出一个国际协议框架，包括：1）明确界定AI研发红线；2）建立分级反制措施（从出口管制到制裁，最终到自卫权承认）；3）要求成员国协调一致地升级威慑措施
AI.findings: 中等强国联盟可以通过协调一致的威慑机制有效防止危险AI研发。协议的有效性关键取决于时机：在行为体确信能通过AI研发获得决定性战略优势之前实施，可以避免极端措施。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）扩展了中等强国在国际安全治理中的作用理论；2）提出了针对新兴技术威胁的分级威慑框架；3）发展了国际协调机制在防止技术军备竞赛中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为中等强国提供了可操作的国际协议模板；2）明确了AI研发的具体红线和反制措施；3）强调了实施时机的重要性；4）为国际社会防止AI军备竞赛提供了具体路径

title: Riemannian Manifolds of Asymmetric Equilibria: The Victoria-Nash Geometry
affiliations: Royal Statistical Society

detail.title: Riemannian Manifolds of Asymmetric Equilibria: The Victoria-Nash Geometry
detail.abstract: We introduce the Victoria-Nash manifold Γ V N AE (θ) as a smooth submanifold arising from an asymmetric expectation field F (s; θ). With a Riemannian metric g(θ) and curvature K(s; θ) encoding asymmetry via a smooth structural field ϕ(s; θ), Γ V N AE generalizes Nash equilibria, von Neumann's minimax theory, and Lyapunov stability. We prove existence, smoothness, and invariance using Lefschetz, Tikhonov, and Lyapunov-Morse theory. Classical equilibria are degenerate limits under complete symmetry and vanishing curvature.

AI.tldr: 本文引入维多利亚-纳什流形Γ_VN_AE(θ)作为从非对称期望场F(s;θ)产生的光滑子流形。该流形通过黎曼度量g(θ)和曲率K(s;θ)编码非对称性，推广了纳什均衡、冯·诺依曼极小极大理论和李雅普诺夫稳定性。作者证明了存在性、光滑性和不变性，并指出经典均衡是完全对称和零曲率下的退化极限。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一的几何框架来推广纳什均衡、冯·诺依曼极小极大理论和李雅普诺夫稳定性理论，并处理非对称博弈情形？
AI.motivation: 经典博弈论中的均衡概念（如纳什均衡）通常假设对称性，而现实世界中的博弈往往存在非对称性。需要发展一个能够统一处理非对称博弈的几何框架，将经典均衡理论作为特例包含其中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 维多利亚-纳什流形理论；2. 黎曼几何与流形理论；3. 非对称期望场理论；4. 拓扑不动点理论（Lefschetz理论）；5. 稳定性理论（Lyapunov-Morse理论）；6. 经典博弈论（纳什均衡、冯·诺依曼极小极大理论）
AI.method: 1. 构建非对称期望场F(s;θ)；2. 定义维多利亚-纳什流形Γ_VN_AE(θ)作为光滑子流形；3. 引入黎曼度量g(θ)和曲率K(s;θ)编码非对称性；4. 使用Lefschetz理论证明存在性；5. 使用Tikhonov理论证明光滑性；6. 使用Lyapunov-Morse理论证明不变性
AI.findings: 1. 维多利亚-纳什流形Γ_VN_AE(θ)存在且为光滑子流形；2. 该流形在适当条件下具有不变性；3. 经典均衡（纳什均衡、冯·诺依曼解）是当系统完全对称且曲率消失时的退化极限；4. 非对称性通过曲率K(s;θ)和结构场ϕ(s;θ)自然编码
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了维多利亚-纳什流形的新概念，统一了博弈论和稳定性理论；2. 建立了非对称博弈的几何框架；3. 将经典均衡理论作为特例包含在更一般的理论中；4. 发展了基于黎曼几何的非对称性编码方法；5. 提供了连接拓扑、几何和博弈论的新桥梁
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为分析现实世界中的非对称博弈提供了新工具；2. 可用于经济学、政治学、生物学等领域的非对称互动建模；3. 为复杂系统的稳定性分析提供了几何视角；4. 可能启发新的算法设计用于寻找非对称博弈的均衡解

title: Forecasting The Real Price of Gasoline in the United States
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Forecasting The Real Price of Gasoline in the United States
detail.abstract:
This notebook develops a complete econometric and statistical forecasting exercise aimed at understanding and predicting the real (inflation-adjusted) price of gasoline in the United States.

Using a dataset that includes monthly gasoline prices and the Consumer Price Index (CPI), the project proceeds through every step of a rigorous time-series forecasting workflow, from data preparation and transformation to model estimation, evaluation, and diagnostic testing.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个完整的计量经济学和统计预测框架，用于理解和预测美国经通胀调整后的汽油实际价格。研究采用月度汽油价格和消费者价格指数数据，执行了从数据准备到模型评估的完整时间序列预测流程。
AI.research_question: 如何准确预测美国经通胀调整后的汽油实际价格？哪些时间序列模型能够最有效地预测汽油价格动态？
AI.motivation: 汽油价格对经济、消费者行为和能源政策具有重要影响。准确预测汽油价格有助于政策制定、企业规划和消费者决策。现有研究需要更系统的时间序列预测方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间序列分析理论、计量经济学预测模型、通货膨胀调整方法、统计诊断测试框架
AI.method: 使用月度汽油价格和CPI数据，执行完整的时间序列预测流程：数据准备、转换、模型估计、评估和诊断测试。采用多种时间序列模型进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 研究展示了完整的时间序列预测工作流程，提供了汽油价格预测的具体模型结果和诊断测试。具体预测精度和最佳模型需要查看完整分析结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了完整的计量经济学预测框架示范，展示了时间序列分析在能源价格预测中的应用，为类似研究提供了方法论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、能源企业和消费者提供了汽油价格预测工具，有助于能源市场分析和经济规划。完整的工作流程可作为其他价格预测项目的模板。

title: When Nature Turns Hazy: How Wildfire Smoke Affects Outdoor Recreation
affiliations: , National Taiwan University and Cornell University - Charles H. Dyson School of Applied Economics and Management

detail.title: When Nature Turns Hazy: How Wildfire Smoke Affects Outdoor Recreation
detail.abstract: How does wildfire smoke affect outdoor recreation across the United States and what are the associated economic costs? Using cellphone mobility data of daily visits to all outdoor nature parks in the contiguous United States during 2018-2019, we combine wildfire plume, pollution, and weather information to provide the first nationwide assessment. Four findings emerge. First, each additional smoke day reduces recreational visits by more than 13%, with the largest declines during heavy smoke episodes. Second, such deterrence effect on recreation is primarily driven by the presence of smoke rather than variations in typical background pollution. Third, responses are highly heterogeneous across contexts: public awareness and prior smoke experience amplify avoidance, trips to non-water-adjacent sites show larger declines, and visits to national parks-where trip flexibility is lower-are less affected. Fourth, visitors adapt through temporal and spatial substitutions but only partially offset economic loss. We estimate that wildfire smoke caused $21 billion (2018 dollars) annually in lost recreational benefits, revealing large and underrecognized social costs extending far beyond burned areas.

AI.tldr: 使用手机移动数据分析美国户外公园访问量，发现野火烟雾导致每年210亿美元娱乐效益损失，烟雾存在而非背景污染是主要影响因素，游客适应性替代仅部分抵消损失。
AI.research_question: 野火烟雾如何影响美国户外娱乐活动？相关的经济成本是多少？
AI.motivation: 野火烟雾对户外娱乐的影响尚未有全国性评估，了解其社会成本对于政策制定和资源管理至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境经济学、行为经济学、灾害经济学、娱乐需求理论
AI.method: 使用2018-2019年美国本土所有户外自然公园的每日手机移动访问数据，结合野火烟雾轨迹、污染和天气信息进行全国性评估
AI.findings: 1. 每增加一个烟雾日减少13%以上访问量，重度烟雾期间下降最大；2. 娱乐活动减少主要由烟雾存在而非背景污染变化驱动；3. 响应存在异质性：公众意识和先前经验增强回避，非水边景点访问下降更大，国家公园受影响较小；4. 游客通过时空替代适应但仅部分抵消损失
AI.theory_contributions: 首次全国性评估野火烟雾对户外娱乐的影响，揭示烟雾存在而非污染水平的独特影响机制，识别响应异质性模式
AI.practical_contributions: 量化野火烟雾每年造成210亿美元娱乐效益损失，为政策制定提供依据，帮助公园管理者制定适应策略，提高公众风险意识

title: Building Trust without Banks: How Reputation Systems Can Make DeFi Safer for Users
affiliations: Cracow University of Economics and Federal College of Agriculture

detail.title: Building Trust without Banks: How Reputation Systems Can Make DeFi Safer for Users

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare that there is no conflict of interest in the work. Thus, we appreciate you if you freelly reference our review.
declarations.ethicsApproval: These is no need for ethics approval
declarations.funderStatement: This is just a part of my research but its not specifically funded

detail.abstract: Decentralized Finance (DeFi) removes traditional intermediaries like banks, letting users lend, borrow, and trade directly through smart contracts. This brings freedom, but also risk. Without central authorities to verify identities or enforce rules, users struggle to tell who or what to trust. Scams like "rug pulls" and price manipulation attacks (e.g., flash loan exploits) remain common. This paper argues that lightweight, transparent reputation systems-built from on-chain activity and simple behavioural signals-can help fill this trust gap. We examine how reputation works (or fails) in current DeFi, propose three practical designs based on real data patterns (transaction consistency, protocol interaction history, and community flagging with appeals), and discuss how to implement them without harming privacy or fairness. We show that such systems can reduce information asymmetry, lower borrowing costs for reliable users, and support financial inclusion-especially for small businesses and individuals underserved by banks. While no reputation system is foolproof, even basic, user-friendly trust signals can make DeFi safer, more predictable, and more equitable. We conclude with suggestions for low-risk testing and policy considerations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于链上活动和行为信号的轻量级透明声誉系统，以解决DeFi中的信任缺失问题，降低可靠用户的借贷成本，促进金融包容性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计轻量级、透明的声誉系统来填补DeFi中的信任缺口，同时保护隐私和公平性？
AI.motivation: DeFi去除了传统金融中介，但缺乏中心化机构的身份验证和规则执行，导致用户难以判断信任对象，诈骗和价格操纵攻击频发。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、声誉机制理论、信任建立理论、金融包容性理论
AI.method: 分析现有DeFi声誉机制问题，基于真实数据模式提出三种实用设计（交易一致性、协议交互历史、社区标记与申诉），讨论实施方法
AI.findings: 轻量级声誉系统能减少信息不对称，降低可靠用户借贷成本，支持金融包容性，特别是对银行服务不足的小企业和个人
AI.theory_contributions: 提出适用于去中心化环境的声誉系统理论框架，扩展了传统金融信任理论在区块链环境的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 提供三种可实施的声誉系统设计方案，提出低风险测试建议和政策考量，使DeFi更安全、可预测和公平

title: Regional Fragmentation and Trade Spillovers in Africa: A Spatial Assessment of Growth Dynamics
affiliations: Central Bank of Nigeria, Abuja, Central Bank of Nigeria, Abuja and Central Bank of Nigeria

detail.title: Regional Fragmentation and Trade Spillovers in Africa: A Spatial Assessment of Growth Dynamics
detail.abstract: This study examines the extent to which regional fragmentation and trade interdependence shape economic growth dynamics in Africa. Using a panel dataset of 35 African countries and employing both static and dynamic Spatial Durbin Models (SDM) with time-fixed effects, the analysis uncovers significant spatial growth spillovers driven by regional integration. The static SDM reveals negative and significant spatial dependence, suggesting that fragmentation dampens regional growth linkages. However, the dynamic specification yields a positive spatial autoregressive coefficient, indicating that in the long run, stronger trade and institutional networks foster mutually reinforcing growth effects across countries. Decomposition of marginal effects shows that labour, human capital, trade openness, and foreign direct investment generate substantial direct (within-country spillovers) and indirect (cross-border spillovers through regional linkages) gains, while inflation and capital accumulation exert adverse spatial effects. The findings highlight the importance of deepening intra-African trade, strengthening regional institutions, and promoting coordinated macroeconomic frameworks to sustain continent-wide growth convergence.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用空间杜宾模型分析非洲35国数据，发现区域碎片化短期内抑制增长联动，但长期来看，更强的贸易和制度网络能促进跨国增长溢出效应。劳动力、人力资本、贸易开放和FDI产生显著的正向空间溢出，而通胀和资本积累则有负面空间效应。
AI.research_question: 区域碎片化和贸易相互依存如何塑造非洲的经济增长动态？
AI.motivation: 理解区域整合对非洲经济增长的影响机制，为促进非洲大陆范围内的增长趋同提供政策依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间经济学理论、区域整合理论、增长溢出效应理论、贸易相互依存理论。
AI.method: 使用35个非洲国家的面板数据，采用静态和动态空间杜宾模型（SDM）并控制时间固定效应。
AI.findings: 1. 静态SDM显示负向显著的空间依赖性，表明碎片化抑制区域增长联动；2. 动态SDM显示正向空间自回归系数，表明长期更强的贸易和制度网络能促进相互强化的跨国增长效应；3. 边际效应分解显示劳动力、人力资本、贸易开放和FDI产生显著的正向直接和间接溢出效应，而通胀和资本积累则有负面空间效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了区域整合对经济增长的空间溢出效应的动态机制；2. 区分了短期碎片化抑制效应和长期整合促进效应；3. 提供了非洲背景下空间增长模型的经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 强调深化非洲内部贸易的重要性；2. 建议加强区域制度建设；3. 提倡协调的宏观经济框架以维持大陆范围内的增长趋同。

title: Experimenting Groundwater GovernanceAssessing Policy Performance through Lab-in-the-field Experiments in Kebili Oases (Tunisia)
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Université Montpellier I, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Montpellier, University of Montpellier, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Experimenting Groundwater GovernanceAssessing Policy Performance through Lab-in-the-field Experiments in Kebili Oases (Tunisia)
detail.abstract: We use laboratory and lab-in-the-field experiments to evaluate policy interventions aimedat curbing the overexploitation of groundwater in southern Tunisia. A framed field ex-periment, based on a dynamic common-pool resource (CPR) model with both static anddynamic externalities, captures the increasing costs of extraction due to current and pastoveruse. Treatments were designed in collaboration with local stakeholders, reflecting real-world constraints such as weak enforcement and limited resources. We test two governancetools—Stakeholder Communication and Expert Advice—against a laissez-faire control, withand without a payoff simulator. Results show that Expert Advice is the most effective at re-ducing extraction, especially in the field setting, underscoring the value of credible, externalguidance in CPR management.

AI.tldr: 通过实验室和实地实验评估突尼斯南部地下水过度开采的政策干预措施，发现专家建议是最有效的治理工具
AI.research_question: 在突尼斯南部地下水管理中，哪些政策干预措施能有效减少过度开采？特别是利益相关者沟通和专家建议这两种治理工具的效果如何？
AI.motivation: 突尼斯南部面临严重的地下水过度开采问题，需要有效的政策干预来管理这一共同池资源，但实际执行中存在执法薄弱和资源有限等现实约束
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于动态共同池资源模型，包含静态和动态外部性，考虑了当前和过去过度使用导致的提取成本增加
AI.method: 使用实验室和实地实验相结合的框架化实地实验，与当地利益相关者合作设计处理条件，测试利益相关者沟通和专家建议两种治理工具，并与自由放任控制组对比，同时考虑有无收益模拟器的影响
AI.findings: 专家建议在减少地下水开采方面最为有效，特别是在实地环境中，强调了在共同池资源管理中可信外部指导的价值
AI.theory_contributions: 为动态共同池资源管理提供了实验证据，展示了专家建议作为治理工具的理论有效性，特别是在存在现实约束的环境中
AI.practical_contributions: 为突尼斯南部地下水管理提供了具体的政策建议，表明专家建议比利益相关者沟通更有效，为当地水资源管理者提供了可行的干预方案

title: Examining Green Finance Resilience during the COVID-19 Pandemic
affiliations: Dublin City University and Dublin City University

detail.title: Examining Green Finance Resilience during the COVID-19 Pandemic

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest to report
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: Not applicable

detail.abstract: This research investigates the market response of green and environmentally focused exchangetraded funds (ETFs) to announcements by the World Health Organisation (WHO) regarding COVID-19 variants. The results show that the direction of investor responses to COVID-19 variants changed significantly over the course of the pandemic. Initial WHO announcements triggered sharp negative market responses, reflecting heightened uncertainty and investor risk aversion. However, market resilience improved as subsequent variant announcements elicited short-term positive reactions, suggesting improved investor confidence in green and environmentally focused investment assets, driven by government support and policies designed to underpin long-term sustainability. Results further illustrate ETFs' ability to mitigate systemic risks and provide portfolio diversification.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了绿色环保ETF对WHO新冠变种公告的市场反应。结果显示投资者反应方向在疫情期间显著变化：初期公告引发负面市场反应，但后续公告则引发短期正面反应，表明投资者对绿色资产的信心增强。
AI.research_question: 绿色环保ETF对WHO新冠变种公告的市场反应如何？投资者反应在疫情期间如何变化？
AI.motivation: 研究绿色投资资产在公共卫生危机中的表现，了解环境可持续性投资在系统性风险下的韧性，以及政府支持政策对投资者信心的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场效率理论、行为金融学（投资者情绪和风险规避）、投资组合理论（风险分散）、可持续投资理论
AI.method: 事件研究法，分析WHO新冠变种公告前后绿色环保ETF的市场反应，可能使用异常收益率和累积异常收益率等指标
AI.findings: 1. 初期WHO公告引发显著负面市场反应，反映不确定性和投资者风险规避；2. 后续变种公告引发短期正面反应，显示市场韧性增强；3. 投资者对绿色环保资产的信心改善，受政府支持政策驱动；4. ETF具有缓解系统性风险和提供投资组合分散化的能力
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了可持续投资在危机时期表现的理论理解；2. 揭示了投资者对绿色资产信心随时间演变的动态过程；3. 为行为金融学在环境投资领域的应用提供实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供绿色资产在危机时期的投资策略指导；2. 为政策制定者展示支持政策对市场信心的积极影响；3. 为资产管理公司设计抗风险绿色投资产品提供依据

title: When do You Expect to be Paid? Expectations Shape Patience
affiliations: University of Technology Sydney, University of Technology Sydney and University of Technology Sydney (UTS)

detail.title: When do You Expect to be Paid? Expectations Shape Patience
detail.abstract: We investigate the effect of the expected timing of payments on elicited time preferences within an experimental framework. The key aspect of our experimental design is that we manipulate the subjects' expectations regarding when they will receive their payments. One group of participants expects their payment in 8 weeks (Future Expectation), while another expects to receive their payments on the same day as the experiment (Today Expectation). We do not manipulate the expectations of the Control group participants, who are likely to have an implicit expectation of receiving their reward on the same day as it is standard to pay subjects in economics experiments just after the participation. We then elicit the time preferences. We find that the Future Expectation group is more patient than the other two groups, and the Today Expectation group is not statistically different from the Control group. These results align with the predictions of a simple theoretical model we developed, which illustrates how expectations over the timing of payment might affect elicited time preferences.

AI.tldr: 研究支付时间预期如何影响时间偏好的实验研究，发现预期未来支付（8周后）的参与者比预期当天支付和对照组更耐心。
AI.research_question: 支付时间预期如何影响实验中被引出的时间偏好？
AI.motivation: 在经济学实验中，支付时间通常是标准化的（实验后立即支付），但现实中支付时间预期可能影响人们的时间偏好决策，需要研究这种预期效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 作者开发了一个简单的理论模型，说明支付时间预期如何影响引出的时间偏好，预测未来支付预期会增加耐心程度。
AI.method: 实验设计：三组参与者（未来预期组-8周后支付，当天预期组-实验当天支付，对照组-无明确预期操纵）。通过操纵支付时间预期，然后引出时间偏好进行测量。
AI.findings: 未来预期组比其他两组更耐心；当天预期组与对照组无统计差异。结果与理论模型预测一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统研究支付时间预期对时间偏好的影响；2. 提供理论框架解释预期如何塑造时间偏好；3. 挑战传统实验中标准化支付时间的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为实验设计提供指导：支付时间预期可能影响结果；2. 对现实决策有启示：支付时间预期影响耐心程度；3. 为政策制定提供参考：调整支付时间预期可能改变行为。

title: Global Turbulence and Inflation: Evidence from Emerging Markets
affiliations: Florida International University (FIU) - Department of Economics

detail.title: Global Turbulence and Inflation: Evidence from Emerging Markets
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how global turbulence measured by geopolitical risks, trade uncertainty, climate policy uncertainty, and supply-chain pressures affects inflation in 58 emerging markets from 1998 to 2024. Using a Bayesian structural vector autoregression framework, we find that geopolitical risks, supply-chain pressures, and climate policy uncertainty are all significant inflationary forces in many emerging markets, whereas trade policy uncertainty has a two-sided effect, proving inflationary in some countries and disinflationary in others. Despite the direct impact of these global factors, our key finding is a currency depreciation having a larger and more immediate impact on domestic inflation than any other turbulence, and exchange rate fluctuations explain the largest share of inflation volatility. These results highlight the critical importance of exchange rate stability and suggest that policymakers should prioritize credible monetary frameworks while simultaneously building economic resilience to the wide array of global shocks.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用贝叶斯结构向量自回归模型分析1998-2024年间58个新兴市场，发现地缘政治风险、供应链压力和气候政策不确定性是通胀的重要推动力，而贸易政策不确定性具有双向效应。最关键的是，货币贬值对国内通胀的影响比其他全球动荡因素更大、更直接，汇率波动解释了通胀波动的最大份额。
AI.research_question: 全球动荡（地缘政治风险、贸易不确定性、气候政策不确定性和供应链压力）如何影响新兴市场的通货膨胀？
AI.motivation: 理解全球动荡因素对新兴市场经济体通胀的影响机制，为政策制定者提供应对全球冲击的有效策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于开放经济宏观经济学理论，特别是汇率传导机制、全球冲击传导理论和通胀决定因素理论。
AI.method: 使用贝叶斯结构向量自回归（BSVAR）框架分析58个新兴市场1998-2024年的数据。
AI.findings: 1. 地缘政治风险、供应链压力和气候政策不确定性是显著的通胀推动力；2. 贸易政策不确定性具有双向效应（在某些国家通胀，在其他国家通缩）；3. 货币贬值对国内通胀的影响比其他全球动荡因素更大、更直接；4. 汇率波动解释了通胀波动的最大份额。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统识别了不同类型全球动荡对新兴市场通胀的差异化影响；2. 强调了汇率传导机制在全球冲击传导中的核心作用；3. 为全球动荡与通胀关系的理论框架提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 政策制定者应优先考虑汇率稳定；2. 需要建立可信的货币政策框架；3. 应同时建立应对各种全球冲击的经济韧性；4. 为新兴市场央行提供了针对不同类型全球动荡的差异化政策建议。
